answer: Score identities by trust that spreads along short random walks from a few known-honest seeds. Honest agents form a dense web of real trades, but a sybil farm, however large, links to that web only through the handful of genuine relationships it managed to earn. Like cargo that can leave an island only by one narrow wharf, trust entering the farm squeezes through those few edges, so a thousand clones split a whisper of it. Clones that mirror each other's links only enlarge the island, never the bridge.
